title: Sindh Board of Technical Education and the Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Amendment Act 2020

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Board of Technical Education and the Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Amendment Act 2020
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XX OF 2020
ACT XX OF 2020
SINDH BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND
THE SINDH BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY
EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act to amend the Sindh Board of Technical
Education
Ordinance, 1970 and the Sindh Board of Intermediate
and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
12th August, 2020]
No.
PAS/LEGIS-B:13/2020, dated 12.8.2020.---The Sindh Board of Technical Education and the Sindh Boards of
Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Bill, 2020 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 23rd July, 2020 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 05th August, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh Board
of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970 and the Boards of Intermediate and
Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Board of Technical Education and the Sindh Boards
of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Act, 2020
(2) It shall
come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect from lst day
of June, 2020.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 12 of Sindh Ordinance No. XVI of 1970

ACT XX OF 2020
ACT XX OF 2020
SINDH BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND
THE SINDH BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY
EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act to amend the Sindh Board of Technical
Education
Ordinance, 1970 and the Sindh Board of Intermediate
and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
12th August, 2020]
No.
PAS/LEGIS-B:13/2020, dated 12.8.2020.---The Sindh Board of Technical Education and the Sindh Boards of
Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Bill, 2020 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 23rd July, 2020 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 05th August, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh Board
of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970 and the Boards of Intermediate and
Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment
of section 12 of Sindh Ordinance No. XVI of 1970.---In the Sindh Board of Technical Education
Ordinance, 1970, in section 12, after subsection (1), the following new
subsection shall be inserted:-
"(1-A)
The Board shall have the power to grant certificate and diploma to the
candidates promoted without examinations due to outbreak of epidemic or
pandemic or Emergency declared by the Government:
Provided
that the promotion of candidates shall be subject to such Standard Operating
Procedures or Policy approved by Government.".
